ucs.title: [LLM] Qilin (Agenda) Safe Mode Boot + Recovery Inhibition pre-encryption chain
ucs.description: Hunts the hallmark Qilin/Agenda ransomware pre-detonation sequence: bcdedit forcing Safe Mode (so EDR drivers don't load) immediately followed by shadow-copy / backup catalog wipes, then a forced reboot. The safeboot pivot is uniquely characteristic of Qilin among major RaaS families — most crews don't bother and instead try to kill EDR in-place.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmdlines values(Processes.process_name) as procs values(Processes.user) as user values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parents from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process_name=bcdedit.exe Processes.process="*safeboot*" Processes.process="*minimal*" OR Processes.process="*network*") OR (Processes.process_name=vssadmin.exe Processes.process="*delete*" Processes.process="*shadow*") OR (Processes.process_name=wmic.exe Processes.process="*shadowcopy*" Processes.process="*delete*") OR (Processes.process_name=wbadmin.exe Processes.process="*delete*" (Processes.process="*catalog*" OR Processes.process="*systemstatebackup*")) OR (Processes.process_name=bcdedit.exe Processes.process="*recoveryenabled*" Processes.process="*no*") by Processes.dest _time span=15m | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | eval has_safeboot=if(match(mvjoin(cmdlines," || "),"(?i)safeboot"),1,0), has_recovery_kill=if(match(mvjoin(cmdlines," || "),"(?i)(shadow|catalog|systemstatebackup|recoveryenabled\s+no)"),1,0) | where has_safeboot=1 AND has_recovery_kill=1 | table firstTime, lastTime, dest, user, parents, procs, cmdlines | sort - firstTime
ucs.kql:
let LookbackHours = 6h;
let WindowMinutes = 30;
let SafeBoot = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackHours)
    | where FileName =~ "bcdedit.exe"
    | where ProcessCommandLine has "safeboot"
    | where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("minimal","network")
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ ("msconfig.exe")   // msconfig is the only sanctioned bcdedit safeboot caller
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | project SafeBootTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
              SafeBootCmd = ProcessCommandLine,
              SafeBootParent = InitiatingProcessFileName;
let RecoveryKill = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackHours)
    | where (FileName =~ "vssadmin.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "delete" and ProcessCommandLine has "shadow")
         or (FileName =~ "wmic.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "shadowcopy" and ProcessCommandLine has "delete")
         or (FileName =~ "wbadmin.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "delete" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("catalog","backup","systemstatebackup"))
         or (FileName =~ "bcdedit.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "recoveryenabled" and ProcessCommandLine has "no")
         or (FileName =~ "bcdedit.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "bootstatuspolicy" and ProcessCommandLine has "ignoreallfailures")
    | project RecoveryTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName,
              RecoveryCmd = ProcessCommandLine, RecoveryBin = FileName;
SafeBoot
| join kind=inner RecoveryKill on DeviceId
| where abs(datetime_diff('minute', SafeBootTime, RecoveryTime)) <= WindowMinutes
| summarize SafeBootCmd = any(SafeBootCmd),
            RecoveryCmds = make_set(RecoveryCmd, 10),
            RecoveryBins = make_set(RecoveryBin, 10),
            FirstSeen = min(SafeBootTime), LastSeen = max(RecoveryTime)
            by DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName
| order by FirstSeen desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:

let RecoveryKill = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackHours)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | where (NewProcessName endswith "vssadmin.exe" and CommandLine has "delete" and CommandLine has "shadow")
         or (NewProcessName endswith "wmic.exe" and CommandLine has "shadowcopy" and CommandLine has "delete")
         or (NewProcessName endswith "wbadmin.exe" and CommandLine has "delete" and CommandLine has_any ("catalog","backup","systemstatebackup"))
         or (NewProcessName endswith "bcdedit.exe" and CommandLine has "recoveryenabled" and CommandLine has "no")
         or (NewProcessName endswith "bcdedit.exe" and CommandLine has "bootstatuspolicy" and CommandLine has "ignoreallfailures")
    | project RecoveryTime = TimeGenerated, Computer, RecoveryCmd = CommandLine,
              RecoveryBin = NewProcessName;
SafeBoot
| join kind=inner RecoveryKill on Computer
| where abs(datetime_diff('minute', SafeBootTime, RecoveryTime)) <= WindowMinutes
| summarize SafeBootCmd = any(SafeBootCmd),
            RecoveryCmds = make_set(RecoveryCmd, 10),
            RecoveryBins = make_set(RecoveryBin, 10),
            FirstSeen = min(SafeBootTime), LastSeen = max(RecoveryTime)
            by Computer, SubjectUserName
| order by FirstSeen desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Qilin/Agenda Safe Mode Boot Pre-Encryption Pivot
id: 6a9c0e1d-7b3a-4f2c-9c1b-3c8d0f7a5e22
status: experimental
description: Detects bcdedit setting the system to boot into Safe Mode (minimal or network), a hallmark Qilin/Agenda ransomware step taken to disable EDR drivers before encryption. Pair with T1490 recovery-inhibition signal for high-fidelity alerting.
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/19
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1562/009/
tags:
  - attack.defense_evasion
  - attack.impact
  - attack.t1562.009
  - attack.t1490
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_bcdedit:
    Image|endswith: '\bcdedit.exe'
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'safeboot minimal'
      - 'safeboot network'
      - '/set safeboot'
  filter_msconfig:
    ParentImage|endswith: '\msconfig.exe'
  filter_machine_acct:
    User|endswith: '$'
  condition: selection_bcdedit and not 1 of filter_*
falsepositives:
  - Administrator troubleshooting via msconfig (filtered)
  - Imaging/provisioning workflows that invoke bcdedit during build
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:(windows.security OR windows.sysmon) (@EventID:4688 OR @EventID:1) ( (@Image:(*\bcdedit.exe OR *\BCDEDIT.EXE OR *\BcdEdit.exe) AND @CommandLine:(*safeboot*minimal* OR *safeboot*network* OR *SAFEBOOT*MINIMAL* OR *SAFEBOOT*NETWORK*)) OR (@Image:(*\vssadmin.exe OR *\VSSADMIN.EXE OR *\VssAdmin.exe) AND @CommandLine:(*"delete shadows"* OR *"Delete Shadows"* OR *"DELETE SHADOWS"*)) OR (@Image:(*\wbadmin.exe OR *\WBADMIN.EXE OR *\WbAdmin.exe) AND @CommandLine:(*"delete catalog"* OR *"delete systemstatebackup"* OR *"delete backup"*)) OR (@Image:(*\wmic.exe OR *\WMIC.EXE OR *\Wmic.exe) AND @CommandLine:*shadowcopy*delete*) OR (@Image:(*\bcdedit.exe OR *\BCDEDIT.EXE) AND @CommandLine:*recoveryenabled*no*) ) -@ParentImage:(*\msconfig.exe OR *\MSCONFIG.EXE)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| ( (ImageFileName=/\\bcdedit\.exe$/i AND CommandLine=/safeboot\s+(minimal|network)/i)
    OR (ImageFileName=/\\vssadmin\.exe$/i AND CommandLine=/delete\s+shadows/i)
    OR (ImageFileName=/\\wmic\.exe$/i AND CommandLine=/shadowcopy\s+delete/i)
    OR (ImageFileName=/\\wbadmin\.exe$/i AND CommandLine=/delete\s+(catalog|backup|systemstatebackup)/i)
    OR (ImageFileName=/\\bcdedit\.exe$/i AND CommandLine=/recoveryenabled\s+no/i)
    OR (ImageFileName=/\\bcdedit\.exe$/i AND CommandLine=/bootstatuspolicy\s+ignoreallfailures/i) )
| NOT (ParentBaseFileName=/msconfig\.exe/i)
| trigger_kind := if(regex("safeboot", field=CommandLine, strict=false), then="safeboot", else="recovery_kill")
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName], function={ count(as=evtCount) | collect([trigger_kind, ImageFileName, CommandLine]) })
| evtCount >= 2
| regex("safeboot", field=trigger_kind)
| regex("recovery_kill", field=trigger_kind)

ucs.title: [LLM] Qilin GPO-distributed Chrome credential harvester (IpScanner.ps1 fan-out)
ucs.description: Hunts Qilin's documented GPO-deployed PowerShell credential harvester that runs at user logon, copies Chrome's Login Data / Cookies / Local State across every endpoint receiving the policy, and stages them on a SYSVOL share. Catches the technique by joining logon-script-spawned PowerShell to Chrome credential-file reads across multiple hosts in a tight window.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as scriptStart from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name IN ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe") (Processes.process="*\\sysvol\\*" OR Processes.process="*\\Policies\\*" OR Processes.parent_process_name IN ("gpscript.exe","userinit.exe")) by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process Processes.parent_process_name | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | rename process as ps_cmd, parent_process_name as ps_parent | join type=inner dest user [| tstats summariesonly=true count as fileAccess min(_time) as accessTime values(Filesystem.file_path) as cred_paths from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where Filesystem.file_path="*\\Google\\Chrome\\User Data\\*" (Filesystem.file_name="Login Data" OR Filesystem.file_name="Cookies" OR Filesystem.file_name="Local State" OR Filesystem.file_name="Web Data") Filesystem.process_name IN ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","esentutl.exe") by Filesystem.dest Filesystem.user | `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)`] | where abs(accessTime - scriptStart) <= 300 | stats dc(dest) as victim_hosts values(dest) as hosts values(ps_cmd) as scripts values(cred_paths) as files min(scriptStart) as firstSeen by user | where victim_hosts >= 3 | sort - firstSeen
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 14d;
let WindowMinutes = 5;
let GpoSpawnedPs = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where FileName in~ ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe")
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("gpscript.exe","userinit.exe","taskeng.exe")
         or ProcessCommandLine has @"\sysvol\"
         or ProcessCommandLine has @"\Policies\"
         or ProcessCommandLine has_any ("IpScanner","ipscanner.ps1","-ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File \\\\")
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | project ScriptTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
              PsCmd = ProcessCommandLine,
              PsParent = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              PsProcId = ProcessId;
let ChromeCredAccess = DeviceFileEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where FolderPath has @"\Google\Chrome\User Data"
    | where FileName in~ ("Login Data","Cookies","Web Data","Local State")
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","esentutl.exe")
    | where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileModified","FileRenamed")
         or InitiatingProcessCommandLine has_any ("Copy-Item","esentutl /y","Get-Content","[IO.File]::ReadAllBytes")
    | project CredTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
              CredFile = strcat(FolderPath, @"\", FileName),
              CredAccessor = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              CredProcId = InitiatingProcessId;
GpoSpawnedPs
| join kind=inner ChromeCredAccess on DeviceId, AccountName
| where abs(datetime_diff('minute', ScriptTime, CredTime)) <= WindowMinutes
| summarize CredFiles = make_set(CredFile, 20),
            SampleCmd = any(PsCmd),
            SampleParent = any(PsParent),
            FirstSeen = min(ScriptTime),
            LastSeen = max(CredTime),
            VictimDevices = make_set(DeviceName, 50)
            by AccountName
| extend VictimCount = array_length(VictimDevices)
| where VictimCount >= 3   // fan-out across >=3 hosts = mass logon-script harvest, not single-user troubleshooting
| order by FirstSeen desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 14d;
let WindowMinutes = 5;
let GpoSpawnedPs = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | where NewProcessName endswith "powershell.exe" or NewProcessName endswith "pwsh.exe"
    | where ParentProcessName endswith "gpscript.exe"
         or ParentProcessName endswith "userinit.exe"
         or CommandLine has @"\sysvol\"
         or CommandLine has @"\Policies\"
         or CommandLine has_any ("IpScanner","ipscanner.ps1")
    | where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
    | project ScriptTime = TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName,
              PsCmd = CommandLine, PsParent = ParentProcessName;
let ChromeCredAccess = ImFileEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where TargetFilePath has @"\Google\Chrome\User Data"
    | where TargetFileName in~ ("Login Data","Cookies","Web Data","Local State")
    | where ActingProcessName has_any ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","esentutl.exe")
    | project CredTime = TimeGenerated, Computer = DvcHostname,
              SubjectUserName = ActorUsername,
              CredFile = strcat(TargetFilePath, @"\", TargetFileName),
              CredAccessor = ActingProcessName;
GpoSpawnedPs
| join kind=inner ChromeCredAccess on Computer, SubjectUserName
| where abs(datetime_diff('minute', ScriptTime, CredTime)) <= WindowMinutes
| summarize CredFiles = make_set(CredFile, 20),
            SampleCmd = any(PsCmd),
            SampleParent = any(PsParent),
            FirstSeen = min(ScriptTime),
            VictimDevices = make_set(Computer, 50)
            by SubjectUserName
| extend VictimCount = array_length(VictimDevices)
| where VictimCount >= 3
| order by FirstSeen desc
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @Image:(*\powershell.exe OR *\POWERSHELL.EXE OR *\PowerShell.exe OR *\pwsh.exe OR *\PWSH.EXE) ( @ParentImage:(*\gpscript.exe OR *\GPSCRIPT.EXE OR *\userinit.exe OR *\USERINIT.EXE) OR @CommandLine:(*\\sysvol\\* OR *\\SYSVOL\\* OR *\\Policies\\* OR *IpScanner* OR *ipscanner.ps1* OR *IPSCANNER.PS1*) ) -@User:(*$ OR SYSTEM OR "NT AUTHORITY\\SYSTEM")
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ImageFileName=/\\(powershell|pwsh)\.exe$/i
| ParentBaseFileName=/(gpscript|userinit)\.exe/i OR regex("(?i)\\\\sysvol\\\\|\\\\Policies\\\\|IpScanner", field=CommandLine)
| NOT UserName=/\$$/
| ps_aid := aid
| ps_user := UserName
| ps_time := @timestamp
| join({
    #event_simpleName=FileOpenInfo OR #event_simpleName=FileWritten
    | regex("\\\\Google\\\\Chrome\\\\User Data\\\\", field=TargetFileName)
    | regex("(Login Data|Cookies|Local State|Web Data)$", field=TargetFileName)
    | ContextImageFileName=/(powershell|pwsh|esentutl)\.exe$/i
  }, field=aid, key=aid, include=[TargetFileName, ContextImageFileName, @timestamp])
| groupBy([ps_user], function={ count(as=hits) | collect([ComputerName, CommandLine, TargetFileName]) })
| count(field=ComputerName, distinct=true, as=victim_hosts)
| victim_hosts >= 3
ucs.rationale: Sophos X-Ops named-and-shamed this exact Qilin tradecraft in Aug 2024: the affiliate dropped a PowerShell harvester (IpScanner.ps1) into the Default Domain Policy's logon-script section, so every domain user touching an affected DC ran it at logon and shipped their Chrome credentials to a SYSVOL collection point. The differentiator vs. generic browser-cred theft is the GPO fan-out shape — same use
